The terrain of the '''Covallon homeworld''' included plains. The [[Covallon]] themselves evolved from a predator [[Species/Legends|species]] that roamed the plains, and they retained certain characteristics due to this origin. Covallon society on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] developed at an early information technology level. Covallon were only rarely seen away from their homeworld and even when they were seen abroad in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], many [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species did not realize they were intelligent.
